title: Benchmark report launch plan + cross-functional asset list (blog/PDF/landing page/webinar/email/enablement)
creator: Soojin Lee
project: Latency per Dollar Benchmark Report (Public Launch)
description:
Goal: coordinate all public + internal assets for the “Production Inference Economics: latency/$” benchmark report launch. This ticket is the single source of truth for: (1) what we are shipping, (2) owners + due dates, (3) dependencies on Eng/Design/Legal/Security, and (4) launch-week run-of-show and post-launch follow-ups.

Launch target: Thu 2025-07-10 09:00 PT (embargo lifts; landing page live; email send; social scheduled)
Executive sponsors: Camila Reyes (VP Marketing), Jordan Blake (CRO)
Launch lead/PMM: Soojin Lee
Program mgmt: Talia Benson

Definition of Done (DoD)
- Public assets live with final copy, disclaimers, and stable links (landing page, interactive table, PDF download, blog)
- Sales enablement kit shipped + posted in Sales Enablement space; AE/SE briefing complete
- Webinar executed or recording published + nurture follow-up scheduled
- Analytics + attribution wired (events, UTMs, HubSpot campaign tag) and dashboard validated
- Legal + Security approvals recorded for final public claims + published artifacts

Asset list (public-facing)
1) Landing page (benchmark hub + methodology summary + CTAs)
- Owner: Wei Chen (docs copy), Alicia Perez (UX), Felix Schneider (implementation)
- Due: 2025-07-03 for final content; 2025-07-08 for final QA; publish 2025-07-10
- Dependencies: PM-826 (requirements/analytics), DES-944/DES-961 (design), ENG-18566 (results service/cache), ENG-18610 (launch-week guardrails)
- Notes: Must include “How we measured” summary, link to full methodology, and clear caveats (variance, workload dependence, region coverage). Ensure accessibility and performance (table loads fast; export works).

2) Interactive benchmark table (filters + exports)
- Owner: Felix Schneider
- Due: 2025-07-08
- Dependencies: ENG-18477 (export pipeline), ENG-18566 (results service), PM-826 (event taxonomy)
- Acceptance: model/region/context-length filters; metric toggles (latency/$, p50/p95, $/1M tokens); CSV export; tooltips for caveats; stable versioning of dataset.

3) Downloadable PDF report
- Owner: Ethan Wallace (narrative), Alicia Perez (layout)
- Due: 2025-07-07 (final for Legal), 2025-07-09 (final export)
- Dependencies: methodology lock from Jonas Weber/Claire Dubois, Legal approval (PM-851), security redaction check (Naomi Feldman)
- Notes: Keep claims consistent with landing page. Include methodology appendix, run parameters at a high level, and a “What this does/doesn’t mean” section.

4) Blog post (launch announcement + key insights)
- Owner: Ethan Wallace; reviewer: Soojin Lee
- Due: 2025-07-02 draft; 2025-07-07 final
- Dependencies: final charts + top-line findings; Legal language review (PM-851)
- Notes: Lead with “production economics” framing; include link to interactive table and PDF; avoid absolute claims. Include ‘how to use this data’ and recommended next steps (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private).

5) Press kit (optional / if time)
- Owner: Soojin Lee; reviewers: Camila Reyes, Michael Grant
- Due: 2025-07-09
- Contents: approved boilerplate, 2–3 approved quotes, key visuals, links, FAQ for press/analysts, embargo language

Asset list (GTM + enablement)
6) Sales enablement kit (talk track, FAQ, deck slide(s), objection handling)
- Owner: Soojin Lee + Markus Klein
- Due: 2025-07-08
- Dependencies: PM-839; Confluence message house + FAQ docs; Legal review sign-off on disallowed phrasing
- Deliverables:
  - 1-slide summary (what changed + top insights)
  - Talk track by segment: dev-first inbound, Dedicated sizing, Private/security-driven
  - FAQ: fairness, caching/batching, variance, competitor comparisons, ‘can you share raw data?’
  - “How to replicate for PoC” short guide (high level; no sensitive details)

7) Webinar: “How we measured latency/$ + how to read the results”
- Owner: Noura El-Khoury (producer)
- Speakers: Jonas Weber (methodology), Renee Sullivan (developer POV), Markus Klein (customer use cases)
- Due: rehearsal 2025-07-08; live 2025-07-10 10:00 PT (or 2025-07-11 depending on speaker availability)
- Dependencies: working interactive page demo; final Q&A bank
- Notes: Have contingency plan if benchmark page slows (screenshots + local table export). Record and publish within 24 hours.

8) Lifecycle/launch emails (PLG + enterprise leads)
- Owner: Ben Carter
- Due: 2025-07-07 final copy; 2025-07-10 send
- Dependencies: landing page final URL; analytics UTMs; approved subject line claims
- Segments:
  - Self-serve/devs: CTA = try Hosted API + view interactive table
  - Enterprise leads: CTA = request Dedicated sizing / Private consult

9) Community + social distribution
- Owner: Camila Reyes team (via Marketing), with Soojin Lee for final approvals
- Due: schedule by 2025-07-09
- Dependencies: final visuals + safe claims; link integrity

Analytics / instrumentation
- Owner: Tyler Benson (ops) + Logan Wright (events)
- Due: 2025-07-09
- Dependencies: PM-826, ENG analytics PR
- Must-have events: page view, filter change (model/region/context), metric toggle, export click, PDF download, CTA click (trial/demo), webinar registration, email click-through.
- Attribution: HubSpot campaign tag “benchmark-report-2025-07” and UTM standardization.

Approvals & reviews
- Legal (Michael Grant, Sofia Mendes): all comparative language, disclaimers, and any competitor contextualization
- Security (Naomi Feldman): verify public artifacts redaction; ensure no sensitive IDs/headers leak; confirm dataset and manifests are safe to publish at the intended granularity
- Product (Henry Cho, Nikhil Sharma): accuracy of product claims; Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private positioning
- Eng/Applied ML (Jonas Weber, Claire Dubois): methodology integrity; confirm no cherry-picking; confirm variance notes

Risks (track in risk log; summarize here)
- Methodology criticism (fairness / representativeness): mitigate with transparent caveats + publish high-level configs + stability notes
- Region capacity variability impacts results/credibility: mitigate via reserved capacity and repeat runs; publish collection window
- Cache miss storm / launch traffic spikes: mitigate with CDN + caching layer readiness and rate-limit guardrails (ENG-18610)
- Sales over-claims: mitigate with disallowed-phrasing section + single talk track; require enablement acknowledgement

Run-of-show (launch day 2025-07-10)
- 07:30 PT: final link check; clear caches; confirm results service healthy
- 08:15 PT: internal go/no-go with PMM + Eng + Legal
- 09:00 PT: publish landing page + blog + PDF; send emails; social goes live; partner posts (if applicable)
- 09:30 PT: open #benchmark-launch-warroom (Marketing + SRE) for first 4 hours
- 10:00 PT: webinar live (or registration push if later)
- 12:00 PT: first KPI check (traffic, signups, demo requests, page latency/5xx)

Post-launch (first 7 days)
- Respond to community questions with canonical methodology link
- Capture top objections from Sales + Support; update FAQ v1.1
- Prepare addendum plan if new model release materially changes tables (define threshold)
- Retro + KPI report by 2025-07-17 (what drove conversions; which CTAs performed)

Links
- Confluence: Benchmark methodology + data validation checklist + runbook (see project page)
- Linear: PM-826 (interactive page reqs), PM-839 (enablement kit), PM-851 (legal review)
- Eng: ENG-18477 (artifact export), ENG-18566 (results service/cache), ENG-18610 (launch monitoring/guardrails)

Open questions (resolved before final publish)
- Whether to show streaming-specific metrics on page vs in footnote only
- Which regions are labeled “supported” vs “experimental” for publication
- Final naming: “latency per dollar” vs “latency/$” in headers (legal preference: define term once; use consistently)
